about_blocks.text: The Youth and Family Inhalant Program is a six month program for young people. The teenagers go through group sessions and counselling much like other programs. But this program also has a school program so that the teenagers continue to get education. There is also education given specifically on addiction and its consequences. They also use some therapy with recreational activities and also physical fitness in order to address not only the mind, but also the body. Those teenagers can successfully get over drug or alcohol addiction and learn to cope with life without using any sort of substance.
